cohort: The study included 137 women selected for vaginal birth after caesarean (VBAC) at the Institute of Woman and Child Health in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
finding: Successful VBAC was positively associated with average body mass index, gestational age 37-40 weeks, ruptured membranes at admission, spontaneous labor, sweeping or stretching as the type of induction, and an estimated fetal weight of 2.5-3.0 kg.
mod_finding: The study identified several factors associated with successful VBAC, including average BMI, gestational age 37-40 weeks, spontaneous labor, ruptured membranes, specific induction types, and EFW 2.5-3.0 kg.
